text: Post-harvest handling and storage (ការរក្សាទុក). Harvest method: pull the roots and set them near the field for initial sorting, then trim off the leaves and move the roots to a cool, shaded area — do not leave harvested roots exposed to direct sunlight. Washing before storage or transport is generally discouraged, since washing shortens shelf life and makes roots more prone to damage in transit; keeping roots clean but unwashed is preferred for storage. For longer-term storage, roots can be kept in cold storage, with temperature lowered to around -4°C, which helps control the microbes that cause the roots to rot. Reported average national yield for this crop in Cambodia is roughly 28-32 tons per hectare, varying with growing season.
